nodes.name: latest_snapshot_pass.json
nodes.summary: Test fixture representing a fully passing snapshot output from the gold engine, with verdict PASS, all guards green, and complete tier1/tier2 series data including quality_summary and values_by_group.
nodes.languageNotes: Gold-engine snapshot schema with 21 top-level keys including guards, revision_risk_summary, tier1_series, tier2_series, quality_summary, values_by_group, and values — used by snapshot regression tests to verify engine output shape and content.

nodes.name: snapshot_fail.json
nodes.summary: Test fixture representing a failing snapshot output with verdict FAIL and guards data_ok and freshness_ok set to false, used to validate that snapshot tests correctly detect and report bad engine outputs.
nodes.languageNotes: Same schema as latest_snapshot_pass.json but with verdict FAIL and guards data_ok=false, freshness_ok=false — exercises the negative path in snapshot regression testing.

nodes.name: snapshot_forced.json
nodes.summary: Test fixture representing a forced snapshot output where verdict is PASS but the forced flag is true, used to test the supervisor-veto bypass and forced-snapshot handling in the gold engine.
nodes.languageNotes: Identical schema to other snapshot fixtures but with forced=true and guards.forced=true, exercising the forced-override execution path through the snapshot guard logic.
